# KindAI Estimating Suite

> KindAI prepares structured estimate drafts from supported plans, a customer's rates and business rules for Australian estimators to review.

KindAI is designed for human-reviewed estimating workflows. It does not replace estimator judgement and does not provide final autonomous bids.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://kindaiestimator.com/): Product overview and founding setup path
- [Pricing](https://kindaiestimator.com/pricing): Visible plans, prices, included users and limits
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://kindaiestimator.com/pricing.md): Plain-text pricing and product limits
- [Interactive sample](https://kindaiestimator.com/demo): Representative sample output; it does not analyse an uploaded plan
- [Founding Workflow Setup](https://kindaiestimator.com/evaluation): Application for the paid cabinet and joinery founding offer
- [Help](https://kindaiestimator.com/help): Supported files and review guidance
- [About](https://kindaiestimator.com/about): Company and founder context
- [Privacy](https://kindaiestimator.com/privacy-policy): Data and privacy terms
- [Terms](https://kindaiestimator.com/terms): Product terms

## Verified commercial summary

- Interactive sample: No charge and no private-plan upload
- Founding Workflow Setup: Proposed A$2,500 plus GST after application approval; one cabinet or joinery workflow, two reviewed jobs and six months of Sole Tradie
- Sole Tradie: A$149/month or A$1,430.40/year, one included user and 20 AI Vision plan readings per month
- Pro and larger configurations: Public proposed pricing is visible, but purchase requires workflow and support scoping
- Upload limit: 32MB per file
